newsitem.title: USA: Hillenbrand Q4 rises before year-ago charge.
newsitem.headline: Hillenbrand Q4 rises before year-ago charge.

text.p: NOTE: Full name is Hillenbrand Industries Inc.

Q4 1995 includes a $26.0 million or $0.37 a share non-cash charge consisting of a $20 million writedown of Block Medical goodwill and a $6 million writedown of certain assets being held for disposition in Europe.
Excluding the charge in Q4 1995, Q4 1996 net income was up 11 percent and earnings per share increased 14 percent.
Full-year 1996 results included $2.0 million after-tax gain on sale of assets of Block Medical and related income tax benefit of $6.0 million.
Full-year 1995 results included the $26.0 million or $0.37 a share charge taken in the fourth quarter.
Excluding the impact in both years of unusual items, net income for fiscal 1996 increased 14 percent from 1995 levels to $132 million and earnings per share rose 16 percent to $1.90.
